plain_english_policy: Support a three-year moratorium on both new hog farms and all expansions of farms to over 500 hogs.

effects.rationale: A moratorium on new hog farms and expansions to over 500 hogs would likely weaken environmental protections by limiting the ability of farmers to expand or start operations.
The moratorium could be seen as a preservation measure if it is intended to protect existing environmental conditions and prevent further degradation due to increased hog farming operations.

evidence_quote: "Support a three-year moratorium on both new hog farms and all expansions of farms to over 500 hogs." - Questionnaire Option for Environment & Energy, Year: 1998.
review_reason: The policy's effect is ambiguous due to the potential dual nature as a preservation measure versus weakening environmental protections.
